description: hsops guards: disruptive server commands (fixed rules 2, 3 and 5) and evidence for writes to the data folder.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" || echo 'hsops: python3 not found, guard hook skipped' >&2
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 -B "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/evidence.py" || echo 'hsops: python3 not found, evidence hook skipped' >&2
